Name.description: The technical name of the query. Must be unique on the tenant.

Source.description: The query source provider name, such as Sql, Lucene or Elasticsearch. The well known members of the query depend on this value.

Schema.description: The optional return schema of the query, used to shape the results when content items are not returned. It supports script expressions such as [js: ...].

ReturnContentItems.description: Whether the query returns full content items instead of the raw source results.

items.description: A query to create or update.

Source.description: Elasticsearch query. Runs an Elasticsearch query against an Elasticsearch index. Fixed 'Source' for the 'Elasticsearch' query source.

Index.description: The name of the Elasticsearch index the query runs against.

Template.description: The Elasticsearch query JSON executed against the index. It supports Liquid and file expressions such as [file:text('Snippets/query.json')].

Source.description: Lucene query. Runs a Lucene query against a Lucene index. Fixed 'Source' for the 'Lucene' query source.

Index.description: The name of the Lucene index the query runs against.

Template.description: The Lucene query JSON executed against the index. It supports Liquid and file expressions such as [file:text('Snippets/query.json')].

Source.description: SQL query. Runs a SQL query against the tenant database. Fixed 'Source' for the 'Sql' query source.

Template.description: The SQL query text executed against the tenant database. It supports Liquid expressions and query parameters such as @limit:3.

Queries.description: The queries to create or update.
